personality_one_liner: A sharp, high-contrast, data-dense scheduling tool designed for fast scanning and immediate operational clarity.

spacing.rule: Use tight, utility-focused spacing to maximize data density. Keep margins predictable and padding compact.

dont's: Do not use glass or blur effects in Dark-First Utility mode.
Avoid translucent overlays on dense data tables.

screens.name: Teraz (Dashboard)
screens.purpose: Show immediate shift status and actionable schedule information without calendar navigation.

states.loading: Skeleton blocks matching the hero card shape.
states.empty: Empty state illustration with text 'Masz dzisiaj wolne' (You have today off).
states.error: Failed to load shift. Retry button in brandPrimary.

screens.layout: Hero card at the top displaying the current/next shift with large Rajdhani times and a location badge. Below the hero card, a 2-column grid showing quick metrics (Hours this week, Pay estimate). Avoid deep nesting.

screens.name: Grafik (Weekly Schedule)
screens.purpose: A week view listing Monday-Sunday shifts, color-coded by assigned worker.

states.error: Failed to load week data. Retry button.

screens.layout: Sticky week navigator pinned at the top (Prev | Current Week | Next). Content is an Agenda/List layout: each day is a section containing 'Zmiana I' (Shift 1) and 'Zmiana II' (Shift 2) cards. Shift cards must show times prominently, accompanied by the worker's avatar and a colored indicator line or pill (blue, purple, or green) denoting the assigned worker.

screens.name: Podsumowanie (Summary)
screens.purpose: Earnings and hours breakdown per worker with filtering.

states.empty: No data for this time period.

screens.layout: Horizontal scrolling chip row at the top to filter by worker name. Below, a large 2-column metric block displaying 'Total Hours' and 'Total Earnings' using oversized Rajdhani font. Beneath the metrics, a flat list of completed shifts.

screens.name: Użytkownicy (Admin Panel)
screens.purpose: Manage team members, roles, and assigned color markers.
screens.layout: List of user rows. Each row includes the user's avatar, name, and a role badge (Admin / Pracownik / Koordynator) inside a surfaceTertiary pill. Include a colored dot next to the name representing their schedule marker color (#3f78ed, #8f6cff, #35c98a).

screens.name: Logowanie (Auth)
screens.purpose: Email/password login, register, or guest access.

states.error: Inline text in error color below input.

screens.layout: Full-screen background image of a dark warehouse with a heavy gradient-to-dark scrim. Login form positioned in the lower 40% of the screen. Inputs use surfaceTertiary background with border highlights on focus.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the Dark-First Utility personality: rely on high contrast, solid dark slate surfaces (#0F172A, #1E293B, #334155), and zero blur/glassmorphism for maximum readability.
Implement the specific colors requested by the user: background uses slate tones, main accent is #3F78ED (blue), and worker markers use blue, purple (#8F6CFF), and green (#35C98A).
Use Rajdhani for all metrics, shift times, and hours to create a tactical, scanner-friendly data hierarchy.
For the Weekly Schedule (Grafik), use an Agenda/List view rather than a compressed grid. This prevents text truncation and ensures location and shift times remain fully legible.
Ensure all primary call-to-action buttons are sticky at the bottom with safe-area padding to respect the thumb zone.
For the Auth login screen, layer a vertical gradient scrim (transparent to #0F172A) over the 'login_hero_bg' image so the login form text remains completely readable.
